Name: Battle Aspergillum
Description: This light mace has a hollow head that can be filled with holy water. The wielder can deliver holy water to undead or evil outsiders as if making a melee touch attack.

Name: Brass Knife
Description: This knife is made of soft brass and is easy to conceal. It has the fragile weapon quality.

Name: Brass Knuckles
Description: These close combat weapons are designed to fit comfortably around the knuckles, narrowing the contact area and magnifying the force delivered by a punch.

Name: Cestus
Description: The cestus is a glove of leather or thick cloth reinforced with metal plates, often with spikes or blades attached over the knuckles.

Name: Dagger
Description: You get a +2 bonus on Sleight of Hand skill checks made to conceal a dagger on your body.

Name: Gauntlet
Description: This metal glove lets you deal lethal damage rather than nonlethal damage with unarmed strikes.

Name: Hanbo
Description: This staff is about 3 feet long. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Handwraps
Description: Handwraps are cloth wraps designed to protect the hands. They don't grant an enhancement bonus on attack rolls or damage rolls, but they can be enhanced as if they were a weapon.

Name: Hook Hand
Description: A hook hand is fitted over a stump left by an amputated hand. The wearer can use it as a weapon.

Name: Kunai
Description: The kunai is a simple iron or steel implement resembling a pointed trowel. Originating as a farming and excavating tool, it's commonly used as a throwing weapon.

Name: Mace, Light
Description: A light mace is made up of an ornate metal head attached to a simple wooden or metal shaft.

Name: Dagger, Punching
Description: A punching dagger's blade is attached to a horizontal handle that projects out from the fist when held.

Name: Sickle
Description: This weapon is used to reap wheat and other grains, but it also makes a fine weapon.

Name: Sickle, Spider-Leg
Description: This sickle has a jagged, barbed blade and can be used to make trip attacks.

Name: Gauntlet, Spiked
Description: An attack with a spiked gauntlet is considered an armed attack. Your opponent cannot use a disarm action to disarm you of spiked gauntlets.

Name: Spring Blade
Description: This blade is hidden within a bracer or under a sleeve until it is needed. You can deploy the blade as a swift action.

Name: Traveling Kettle
Description: This reinforced kettle can be used as a weapon. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Wooden Stake
Description: A wooden stake is useful against vampires and other creatures harmed by wood. It can also be thrown.

Name: Baston, Fighting Stick
Description: This hardwood stick is used as a training weapon and for fighting. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Club
Description: A wooden club is so simple that anyone can find one lying around.

Name: Mace, Heavy
Description: A heavy mace has a larger head and a longer handle than a light mace.

Name: Mere Club
Description: Carved from a single piece of stone or bone, the mere is a traditional weapon of the Polynesians.

Name: Morningstar
Description: A morningstar is a spiked metal ball, affixed to the top of a long handle.

Name: Shortspear
Description: A shortspear is about 3 feet in length, making it a suitable thrown weapon.

Name: Bayonet
Description: Bayonets are close combat weapons designed to fit into the grooves or muzzles of crossbows and firearms. Bayonets can be attached or removed as a move action.

Name: Boar Spear
Description: This spear with a spiraling blade has a metal crossbar approximately halfway down its length. The crossbar prevents creatures from moving forward beyond your square when set against a charge.

Name: Boarding Pike
Description: A boarding pike is a long spear used on ships to repel boarders. It has reach, allowing you to strike opponents 10 feet away.

Name: Kumade
Description: This polearm consists of a long pole with a metal basket similar to a bear trap at the top. It can be used to hook and pull opponents.

Name: Kumade, Collapsible
Description: The metal basket of this kumade can collapse into the haft for easy transport. Deploying or collapsing the kumade is a move action.

Name: Lantern Staff
Description: This staff has a lantern mounted at the top. The lantern can be lit and provides illumination as a normal lantern.

Name: Longspear
Description: A longspear is about 8 feet in length. You can strike opponents 10 feet away with it, but you can't use it against an adjacent foe.

Name: Quarterstaff
Description: A quarterstaff is a simple piece of wood, about 5 feet in length. You can strike with either end.

Name: Spear
Description: A spear is 5 feet in length and can be thrown. If you use a ready action to set a spear against a charge, you deal double damage on a successful hit.

Name: Spear, Weighted
Description: This spear has a weighted butt end that can be used as a separate weapon. It functions as a double weapon.

Name: Blowgun
Description: Blowguns are generally used to deliver debilitating poisons from a distance. They are nearly silent when fired.

Name: Dart
Description: Darts are missile weapons designed to fly such that a sharp, often weighted point will strike first.

Name: Crossbow, Heavy
Description: You draw a heavy crossbow back by turning a small winch. Loading is a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

Name: Javelin
Description: A javelin is a thin throwing spear. You take a –4 penalty on attack rolls if you use a javelin as a melee weapon.

Name: Crossbow, Light
Description: You draw a light crossbow back by pulling a lever. Loading is a move action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

Name: Sling
Description: A sling is a leather cup attached to a pair of strings. Your Strength modifier applies to damage rolls. Loading is a move action that requires two hands.

Name: Stingchuck
Description: This woven textile weapon contains a hole for your thumb and a small net that holds a jagged stone or similar projectile.

Name: Stonebow
Description: A stonebow is a crossbow that fires stones or bullets instead of bolts.

Name: Underwater Crossbow, Heavy
Description: This weapon functions like a heavy crossbow but can be used underwater without penalty.

Name: Underwater Crossbow, Light
Description: This weapon functions like a light crossbow but can be used underwater without penalty.

Name: Unarmed Strike
Description: An unarmed strike is always considered a light weapon. You can use the Weapon Finesse feat to apply your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier to attack rolls.

Name: Amentum
Description: An amentum is a leather thong that attaches to a javelin. Before throwing, you wrap it around the javelin's shaft. It takes a move action but increases range. It has the performance weapon quality.

Name: Ankus
Description: This hooked staff is used to control elephants and other large animals. It can be used to disarm or trip opponents.

Name: Armor, Spiked
Description: You can have spikes added to your armor, allowing you to deal extra piercing damage on a successful grapple attack. Weight is included in armor.

Name: Atlatl
Description: An atlatl is a thin piece of wood or antler used as a lever to hurl a specially fitted dart with greater range and force.

Name: Bardiche
Description: The crescent-bladed bardiche is a polearm with reach. You can use it to make trip attacks. If you are tripped during your own trip attempt, you can drop the bardiche to avoid being tripped.

Name: Battleaxe
Description: The handle of this axe is long enough that you can wield it one-handed or two-handed. The head may have one blade or two.

Name: Bec de Corbin
Description: The bec de corbin is a polearm with a hammer head balanced by a spike. It has reach.

Name: Bill
Description: The bill is a polearm with a hooked blade. It has reach and can be used to disarm opponents.

Name: Blade Boot
Description: A blade boot is a sharp-pointed blade that is strapped to the bottom of your boot. You can use it to make powerful kicks.

Name: Boarding Axe
Description: Boarding axes are the favorite weapon for ship-to-ship combat. They are equally useful for chopping through rigging and boarding enemy vessels.

Name: Butterfly Sword
Description: These short matching swords come in pairs, cleverly nested together to appear as a single blade. Monks are proficient with butterfly swords.

Name: Cat-o'-Nine-Tails
Description: A cat-o'-nine-tails is a whip with nine knotted thongs. It deals nonlethal damage and can be used to disarm opponents.

Name: Chakram
Description: The chakram is a simple, elegant, and highly portable thrown weapon. It is a flat, open-centered metal discus with a sharpened edge.

Name: Combat Scabbard
Description: This scabbard is designed to be used as a weapon. When empty, it can be wielded as a club.

Name: Combat Scabbard, Sharpened
Description: This scabbard has a sharpened edge and can be used as a slashing weapon even when it contains a blade.

Name: Cutlass
Description: This slightly curved sword is a favorite of pirates and sailors. Its heavy basket hilt protects the hand.

Name: Dogslicer
Description: This short, curved sword is a favorite weapon of goblins, who use it to deadly effect against dogs.

Name: Double Chicken Saber
Description: This sword has an intricate guard that can catch and disarm opponents' weapons. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Dueling Dagger
Description: This dagger has a long, thin blade and an ornate basket hilt. When fighting defensively or using Combat Expertise, you gain an additional +1 shield bonus to AC.

Name: Earth Breaker
Description: The earth breaker is a massive hammer, often carved from a single piece of iron or stone.

Name: Falchion
Description: This sword has one curved, sharp edge like a scimitar, with the back edge unsharpened.

Name: Flail, Heavy
Description: Similar to a flail, a heavy flail has a larger metal ball and a longer handle.

Name: Flail, Light
Description: A flail consists of a spiked metal ball, connected to a handle by a sturdy chain.

Name: Gandasa
Description: This is a large, heavy axe with a distinctive curved blade. It's favored by executioners.

Name: Gastraphetes
Description: The gastraphetes is an ancient, heavy crossbow. Loading it is a full-round action that requires placing the bow on the ground and using a lever.

Name: Gladius
Description: The gladius is the favorite short sword of gladiators. It has the performance weapon quality.

Name: Glaive
Description: A glaive is a simple blade, mounted to the end of a pole about 7 feet in length.

Name: Glaive-Guisarme
Description: This polearm combines the blade of a glaive with the hook of a guisarme. It has reach and can be used to make trip attacks.

Name: Greataxe
Description: This big, heavy axe is a favorite of barbarians and anybody else who wants to deal out incredible damage.

Name: Greatclub
Description: A greatclub is a two-handed version of a regular club. It is often studded with nails or spikes.

Name: Greatsword
Description: This immense two-handed sword is about 5 feet in length.

Name: Guisarme
Description: A guisarme is an 8-foot-long shaft with a blade and a hook mounted at the tip.

Name: Halberd
Description: A halberd is a combination of a spear and an axe. The spike at the end is used like a spear, the axe blade is used for slashing, and the hook opposite the blade is used for tripping.

Name: Hammer, Light
Description: This small hammer is perfect for throwing or close combat.

Name: Handaxe
Description: This one-handed axe is short (roughly 1 foot long) and designed for use with one hand.

Name: Hooked Lance
Description: This slender spear has a hook near the head that can be used to trip opponents.

Name: Horsechopper
Description: This polearm combines a blade with a hook. Goblins use it to dismount riders.

Name: Hunga Munga
Description: This curved throwing blade has multiple sharpened edges and points.

Name: Hurlbat
Description: The hurlbat is a throwing axe with a blade on one side and a spike on the other.

Name: Iron Brush
Description: This is an iron-handled version of a scholar's brush. The iron brush can be used as a weapon.

Name: Jolting Dart
Description: This dart has a small reservoir that can hold one dose of liquid. On a hit, the liquid is injected into the target.

Name: Jutte
Description: This short metal weapon has a curved prong that can be used to disarm opponents. Monks are proficient with the jutte.

Name: Katar, Tri-Bladed
Description: This punching dagger has three blades that deploy when the weapon is thrust forward. It has an increased critical multiplier.

Name: Kerambit
Description: This small, curved blade is worn on a finger ring and has a wicked hooked point.

Name: Klar
Description: The klar is a short blade bound to a large lizard skull. A klar serves as a light shield when you aren't using it as a weapon.

Name: Kukri
Description: A kukri is a curved blade, about 1 foot in length.

Name: Lance
Description: A lance deals double damage when used from the back of a charging mount. While mounted, you can wield a lance with one hand.

Name: Lizard King War Trident
Description: This oversized trident is designed for lizardfolk. It deals damage based on the wielder's size.

Name: Longbow
Description: You need two hands to use a bow, regardless of its size. A longbow is too unwieldy to use while you are mounted.

Name: Longbow, Composite
Description: You need at least two hands to use a bow. You can use a composite longbow while mounted. All composite bows are made with a particular Strength rating allowing you to add your Strength bonus to damage, up to the maximum bonus indicated for the bow.

Name: Longsword
Description: This classic, straight blade is the weapon of knighthood and valor.

Name: Lucerne Hammer
Description: This polearm has a hammer head balanced by a spike. It has reach and can be set against a charge.

Name: Lungchuan Tamo
Description: This weapon is a tiny dagger with a curved blade. Monks are proficient with the lungchuan tamo.

Name: Machete
Description: This wide-bladed knife is designed for cutting through thick vegetation. It makes an effective weapon.

Name: Manople
Description: This stiff, heavy glove has a blade or spike mounted on the back of the hand. It has blocking and disarm special features.

Name: Mattock
Description: A mattock is a digging tool that makes a serviceable weapon. It has the fragile quality.

Name: Monk's Spade
Description: This weapon has a sharpened spade blade on one end and a crescent blade on the other. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Naginata
Description: A naginata is a polearm with a curved blade on the end. It has reach.

Name: Nine-Ring Broadsword
Description: This broad-bladed sword has nine heavy rings threaded through the back of the blade. The rings make a distinctive sound. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Nodachi
Description: This very long, curved sword is even longer than a katana. It can be set against a charge.

Name: Ogre Hook
Description: This large, curved blade is used by ogres to hook and drag down opponents.

Name: Phaleros
Description: A phaleros is a throwing dart with a wide, leaf-shaped head.

Name: Pick, Heavy
Description: A heavy pick is a one-handed tool designed to concentrate the force of its blow on a small area.

Name: Pick, Light
Description: A light pick is a one-handed tool designed to concentrate the force of its blow on a small area.

Name: Pickaxe
Description: A pickaxe is a mining tool that can be used as a weapon.

Name: Pilum
Description: A pilum is a javelin with a pyramidal head. If a pilum hits a shield, it becomes lodged and makes the shield difficult to use.

Name: Planson
Description: The planson is a polearm with a cutting blade set at a right angle to the shaft.

Name: Poisoned Sand Tube
Description: This weapon is a tube filled with poisoned sand. You can blow the sand into an adjacent target's face, forcing them to save against the poison.

Name: Ranseur
Description: Similar in appearance to a trident, a ranseur has a single spear at its tip, flanked by a pair of short, curving blades.

Name: Rapier
Description: You can use the Weapon Finesse feat to apply your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier to attack rolls with a rapier.

Name: Reflex Bow
Description: This shortbow has a unique construction that allows it to be used while mounted without penalty.

Name: Rhomphaia
Description: The rhomphaia is a polearm with a curved blade. It has reach and can be set against a charge. It has the fragile quality.

Name: Sansetsukon
Description: This weapon consists of three wooden or metal rods connected by short chains. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Sap
Description: A sap is a leather pouch, loaded with powdered lead. It deals nonlethal damage.

Name: Sarissa
Description: The sarissa is an extremely long spear, up to 20 feet in length. It has reach and can be set against a charge.

Name: Scimitar
Description: This curved sword is shorter than a longsword and longer than a shortsword.

Name: Scizore
Description: The scizore is a hardened tube of metal designed to be fitted over a forearm. It has a blade that extends from the wrist. It has the performance weapon quality.

Name: Scythe
Description: A farm implement used for harvesting wheat, a scythe requires proficiency with martial weapons. A scythe can be used to make trip attacks.

Name: Sea-Knife
Description: This short, curved blade is designed for use on ships and in naval combat.

Name: Shang Gou
Description: This weapon resembles a shepherd's crook. Monks are proficient with the shang gou. You can use it to disarm or trip opponents.

Name: Shield, Heavy
Description: You can bash with a heavy shield. A heavy shield is so heavy that you can't use your shield hand for anything else. Weight varies by material.

Name: Shield, Light
Description: You can bash with a light shield. When you do so, you use your shield like a light weapon. Weight varies by material.

Name: Shield, Spiked Heavy
Description: You can bash with a spiked heavy shield. The spikes deal piercing damage. Weight varies by material.

Name: Shield, Spiked Light
Description: You can bash with a spiked light shield. The spikes deal piercing damage. Weight varies by material.

Name: Shortbow
Description: You need two hands to use a bow, regardless of its size. You can use a shortbow while mounted.

Name: Shortbow, Composite
Description: You need at least two hands to use a bow. You can use a composite shortbow while mounted. All composite bows are made with a particular Strength rating.

Name: Shortsword
Description: This sword is popular as an off-hand weapon or a primary weapon for Small creatures.

Name: Sibat
Description: This weapon is a short spear with a single blade or multiple smaller blades. It can be thrown and used to grapple.

Name: Spear-Sling
Description: This device allows you to throw a spear much farther than normal. The range increment is based on the spear used.

Name: Starknife
Description: This 4-pointed blade resembles a star and can be used as a melee weapon or thrown.

Name: Switchblade Knife
Description: This knife has a spring-loaded blade hidden in the handle. You can deploy the blade as a free action.

Name: Sword Cane
Description: This slender light blade lies within a wooden container that serves as both its scabbard and hiding place. You can draw the blade as a swift action.

Name: Syringe Spear
Description: This spear has a hollow head that can hold one dose of poison. On a hit, the poison is delivered to the target.

Name: Tailblade, Ratfolk
Description: A tailblade is a small, sharp blade designed to be strapped to a ratfolk's tail, making it a dangerous weapon.

Name: Tepoztopilli
Description: This polearm has a head lined with obsidian shards. It has reach and the fragile quality.

Name: Terbutje
Description: This sword has a blade of volcanic glass. It has the fragile weapon quality.

Name: Terbutje, Steel
Description: This is a steel version of the terbutje. It lacks the fragile quality.

Name: Throwing Arrow Cord
Description: This simple cord can be used to throw an arrow by hand with surprising range and accuracy.

Name: Throwing Axe
Description: This light axe is perfectly balanced for throwing, though it can also be used in melee.

Name: Tiger Fork
Description: The tiger fork is a long, trident-like polearm. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Tonfa
Description: This wooden club has a side handle. Monks are proficient with the tonfa. It has the blocking special feature.

Name: Tri-Point Double-Edged Sword
Description: This polearm has three blades arranged in a fan-like pattern. It has reach.

Name: Trident
Description: A trident has three metal prongs at the end of a 4-foot-long shaft. This weapon can be thrown.

Name: Tube Arrow Shooter
Description: This hollow tube allows you to shoot arrows without a bow by placing an arrow in the tube and sharply striking the back.

Name: War Razor
Description: This is an oversized, sharpened straight razor. It folds into its handle for safe storage.

Name: Warhammer
Description: This weapon, common among dwarves, is a one-handed sledge with a large, heavy head.

Name: Wushu Dart
Description: This sharpened needle is designed for throwing. Monks are proficient with wushu darts.

Name: Aklys
Description: An aklys is a hooked throwing club with a cord attached. You can retrieve it after throwing as a move action. It has the performance weapon quality.

Name: Aldori Dueling Sword
Description: This sword is the signature weapon of the Aldori swordlords. It is perfectly balanced for dueling.

Name: Axe-Gauntlet, Dwarven Heavy
Description: This axe blade is attached to a reinforced gauntlet. It cannot be disarmed and has blocking and disarm special features.

Name: Axe-Gauntlet, Dwarven Light
Description: This axe blade is attached to a gauntlet. It cannot be disarmed and has blocking and disarm special features.

Name: Barbazu Beard
Description: This artificial metal beard is strapped to your chin and has jagged blades you can use as a weapon.

Name: Barbed Spear
Description: This spear has backward-facing barbs that tear flesh when removed. It has reach and the fragile quality.

Name: Battle Ladder, Gnome
Description: This folding ladder can be used as a double weapon and for climbing. Gnomes treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Battle Poi
Description: Battle poi are a pair of fire-poi designed for combat. They deal fire damage and can be used to dazzle opponents.

Name: Bich'hwa
Description: This double-curved dagger has a distinctive loop-shaped hilt. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Bladed Scarf
Description: This scarf has blades sewn into it. It can be used to disarm and trip opponents.

Name: Bo Staff
Description: This six-foot staff can be used as a double weapon. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Boarding Gaff
Description: This pole has hooks on both ends. It can be used as a double weapon with reach.

Name: Bolas
Description: A bolas is a pair of weights connected by a cord. You can use this weapon to make a ranged trip attack. You can't be tripped during your own trip attempt when using a bolas.

Name: Boomerang
Description: A boomerang is a curved throwing weapon. If it misses, it flies back to your square.

Name: Broken-Back Seax
Description: This sword has a distinctive angled back. It deals both piercing and slashing damage.

Name: Butchering Axe
Description: This massive axe is designed for chopping through bone and flesh.

Name: Butterfly Knife
Description: This folding knife can be deployed with a flick of the wrist. Deploying it is a free action.

Name: Chain Spear
Description: This weapon has a spear point on one end and a blade on a chain on the other.

Name: Chain-Hammer
Description: This weapon has hammers on chains at both ends. It can be used as a double weapon or thrown.

Name: Crook
Description: This shepherd's crook can be used to trip opponents. It has reach.

Name: Crystal Chakram
Description: This chakram is made of crystal and has an improved critical threat range.

Name: Dan Bong
Description: A dan bong is a short stick designed to be gripped in the hand. Monks are proficient with this weapon. It has the blocking special feature.

Name: Deer Horn Knife
Description: This crescent-shaped blade resembles deer antlers. Monks are proficient with this weapon. It has the blocking special feature.

Name: Dire Bolas
Description: These are larger, heavier bolas designed to entangle larger creatures.

Name: Dorn-Dergar, Dwarven
Description: This dwarven war hammer has a long handle. It has reach. Dwarves treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Doru
Description: The doru is a short spear. It can be thrown and can be set against a charge.

Name: Double Crossbow
Description: This heavy crossbow has two strings and can fire two bolts with a single trigger pull.

Name: Double Spear
Description: This weapon has spear points on both ends. It can be used as a double weapon.

Name: Double Walking Stick Katana
Description: This walking stick conceals two katana blades that can be drawn quickly.

Name: Double-Chained Kama
Description: Two kama connected by a chain. Monks are proficient with this weapon. It has reach.

Name: Dwarven Double Waraxe
Description: This double-bladed axe can be wielded as a double weapon. Dwarves treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Dwarven Maulaxe
Description: This axe head is mounted on a stout handle with a hammer on the back. It can deal bludgeoning or slashing damage.

Name: Elven Branched Spear
Description: This spear has small branches that can catch weapons. It has reach and can be set against a charge. Elves treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Elven Curve Blade
Description: Essentially a two-handed scimitar, this blade is highly valued by elves. Elves treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Elven Leafblade
Description: This blade is shaped like an elongated leaf. Elves treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Elven Thornblade
Description: This blade is covered in thorn-like projections. Elves treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Emei Piercer
Description: This weapon consists of a metal ring worn on the middle finger with a sharp spike extending from the ring. It leaves your hand free to use other weapons or objects.

Name: Estoc
Description: This long, thin sword is designed for thrusting. It is highly effective at piercing armor.

Name: Falcata
Description: This curved sword has a weighted blade that delivers powerful chopping blows.

Name: Fauchard
Description: This polearm has a curved blade. It has reach and can be used to trip.

Name: Fighting Fan
Description: This metal fan has sharpened edges. Monks are proficient with this weapon. It has the distracting special feature.

Name: Flail, Dire
Description: A dire flail is a double flail. Each end can be used as a separate weapon.

Name: Flailpole
Description: This polearm has a flail head. It has reach and can be used to disarm and trip.

Name: Flambard
Description: This sword has a wavy blade. It has the sunder special feature.

Name: Flask Pike
Description: This pike has a compartment that can hold alchemical substances. It has reach.

Name: Flask Thrower
Description: This device allows you to throw alchemical flasks farther and more accurately.

Name: Flindbar
Description: This weapon has a spiked ball connected to a handle by a chain. It can be used to disarm and trip.

Name: Flying Blade
Description: This large blade on a pole can be spun dramatically. It has the performance weapon quality and reach.

Name: Flying Talon
Description: This weapon is a spring-loaded claw on an extendable arm. It has reach and can be used to disarm or trip.

Name: Garrote
Description: This wire is used to strangle opponents. It can only be used against grappled or helpless targets.

Name: Giant-Sticker, Dwarven
Description: This dwarven polearm is designed for fighting giants. It has reach and can be set against a charge.

Name: Gnome Flick-Mace
Description: This gnomish weapon has an extending handle. As a swift action, you can extend it to gain reach or retract it.

Name: Gnome Hooked Hammer
Description: A gnome hooked hammer is a double weapon with a hammer head and a hook. Gnomes treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Gnome Pincher
Description: This weapon resembles oversized tongs. It can be used to disarm opponents and grab objects.

Name: Grappling Hook
Description: A grappling hook can be thrown and used as a weapon or for climbing.

Name: Great Terbutje
Description: This larger version of the terbutje has a blade of volcanic glass. It has the fragile weapon quality.

Name: Halfling Double Sling
Description: This weapon can fire two bullets at once. Halflings treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Halfling Rope-Shot
Description: This weapon is a weighted pouch on the end of a rope. It can be used to disarm opponents.

Name: Halfling Sling Staff
Description: This staff has a sling at the end for hurling projectiles. Halflings treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Halfling Stitched Sling
Description: This sling is designed to hurl unusual projectiles. Halflings treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Hand Crossbow
Description: This is a miniature crossbow designed to be held in one hand. Loading is a move action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

Name: Harpoon
Description: A harpoon is a barbed spear with an attached rope. If you hit, the harpoon lodges in the target.

Name: Heavy Crank Crossbow
Description: This heavy crossbow has a cranking mechanism. Loading it is a full-round action.

Name: Heavy Slaver's Crossbow
Description: This crossbow fires bolas bolts designed to entangle targets.

Name: Heavy Wrist Launcher
Description: This device is strapped to your wrist and fires darts.

Name: Helmet, Dwarven Boulder
Description: This reinforced helmet can be used as a weapon when headbutting opponents.

Name: Hooked Axe
Description: This axe has a hook on the back. It has the performance weapon quality and can be used to disarm and trip.

Name: Hornbow, Orc
Description: This bow is made from horn and is favored by orcs. Orcs treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Horse Bow
Description: This bow is designed for use while mounted.

Name: Injection Spear
Description: This spear has a hollow tip that can inject poison on a successful hit.

Name: Kama
Description: Similar to a sickle, a kama is a short, curved blade attached to a simple handle. Monks use this weapon. It can be used to make trip attacks.

Name: Kasatha Spinal Sword
Description: This sword is made from vertebrae linked by wire. It has the fragile weapon quality.

Name: Katana
Description: This curved sword is the signature weapon of samurai. It has the deadly special feature. Characters can use a katana two-handed as a martial weapon.

Name: Katar, Tri-Bladed
Description: This punching dagger has three blades that deploy when thrust forward.

Name: Kestros
Description: This sling-like weapon hurls darts with great force.

Name: Khopesh
Description: This curved sword has a distinctive hooked blade. It can be used to make trip attacks.

Name: Knobkerrie
Description: This club has a large knob at the end. It can be thrown.

Name: Knuckle Axe
Description: This axe blade is mounted on brass knuckles. Monks are proficient with this weapon. It has the performance weapon quality.

Name: Kusarigama
Description: This weapon consists of a kama attached to a weighted chain. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Kyoketsu Shoge
Description: This weapon has a knife on a rope with a ring. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Lasso
Description: This rope with a noose can be used to grapple opponents.

Name: Launching Crossbow
Description: This crossbow is designed to launch alchemical items.

Name: Light Crank Crossbow
Description: This light crossbow has a cranking mechanism.

Name: Light Slaver's Crossbow
Description: This light crossbow fires bolas bolts designed to entangle targets.

Name: Longaxe, Dwarven
Description: This dwarven poleaxe has reach. Dwarves treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Longhammer, Dwarven
Description: This massive dwarven hammer has a long handle. It has reach. Dwarves treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Madu, Leather
Description: A madu is a round, light shield with sharp spikes protruding from the center. It has the performance weapon quality.

Name: Madu, Steel
Description: A steel madu is a round, light shield with sharp spikes protruding from the center. It has the performance weapon quality.

Name: Mancatcher
Description: This polearm has a spring-loaded set of jaws. It can be used to grapple opponents at reach.

Name: Meteor Hammer
Description: This weapon consists of one or two weights on a long rope. It has reach and can trip.

Name: Net
Description: A fighting net has small barbs in the weave and a trailing rope to control netted opponents. You can use it to entangle opponents. It is a ranged touch attack.

Name: Nine-Section Whip
Description: This weapon consists of nine metal rods connected by chain. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Nunchaku
Description: A nunchaku is made up of two wooden or metal bars connected by a small length of rope or chain. Monks use this weapon.

Name: Orc Double Axe
Description: An orc double axe is a double weapon with axe heads on both ends. Orcs treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Orc Skull Ram
Description: This massive skull-headed hammer has reach. Orcs treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Pata
Description: A pata is a short sword mounted on a gauntlet. It has the performance weapon quality.

Name: Pelletbow, Dwarven Heavy
Description: This dwarven crossbow fires pellets instead of bolts. Dwarves treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Pelletbow, Dwarven Light
Description: This light dwarven crossbow fires pellets instead of bolts. Dwarves treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Piston Maul, Gnome
Description: This gnomish hammer has a piston mechanism. Gnomes treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Quadrens
Description: This four-pronged dagger is designed for gladiatorial combat. It has the performance weapon quality.

Name: Ram Hammer, Dwarven
Description: This heavy hammer has a ram's head design. It can be thrown.

Name: Razor, Drow
Description: This wickedly sharp blade is favored by drow. Drow treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Repeating Hand Crossbow
Description: This hand crossbow has a magazine that holds 5 bolts. Loading the magazine is a full-round action.

Name: Repeating Heavy Crossbow
Description: The repeating heavy crossbow holds 5 bolts. Loading the magazine is a full-round action.

Name: Repeating Light Crossbow
Description: The repeating light crossbow holds 5 bolts. Loading the magazine is a full-round action.

Name: Rhoka Sword
Description: This distinctive curved sword is designed for mounted combat.

Name: Ripsaw Glaive, Gnome
Description: This gnomish glaive has a serrated blade. It has reach. Gnomes treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Rope Dart
Description: This dart on a rope can be retrieved after throwing. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Rope Gauntlet
Description: This gauntlet is wrapped in heavy rope that can be used as a weapon.

Name: Sai
Description: A sai is a metal spike flanked by a pair of prongs used to trap an enemy's weapon. Monks use this weapon.

Name: Sanpkhang
Description: This crescent-shaped blade is designed to be concealed. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Sawtooth Sabre
Description: This sabre has a serrated edge. It deals bleed damage on critical hits.

Name: Scorpion Whip
Description: This whip has a blade at the end. It has the performance weapon quality.

Name: Seven-Branched Sword
Description: This sword has six prongs along the blade. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Shoanti Bolas
Description: These bolas have sharp hooks that deal piercing damage in addition to bludgeoning.

Name: Shotel
Description: This curved blade can reach around shields. It has the performance weapon quality.

Name: Shrillshaft Javelin
Description: This javelin makes a loud whistling noise when thrown.

Name: Shuriken
Description: A shuriken is a small piece of metal with sharpened edges, designed for throwing. Monks use this weapon. Shuriken are sold in sets of five.

Name: Siangham
Description: This weapon is a handheld shaft fitted with a pointed blade. Monks use this weapon.

Name: Sica
Description: This curved dagger is designed for gladiatorial combat. It has the performance weapon quality.

Name: Sickle-Sword
Description: This sword has a sickle-shaped blade. It has the distracting special feature.

Name: Sling Glove
Description: This sling is built into a glove, allowing you to use it without occupying a hand.

Name: Snag Net
Description: This net has hooks that can snag and trip opponents.

Name: Sphinx Hammer, Dwarven
Description: This dwarven hammer can be thrown. Dwarves treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Spiked Chain
Description: A spiked chain has reach. You can strike opponents 10 feet away with it. You can use the Weapon Finesse feat to apply your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier to attack rolls with a spiked chain sized for you, even though it isn't a light weapon.

Name: Spiral Rapier
Description: This rapier has a spiral blade. It has blocking and disarm special features.

Name: Split-Blade Sword
Description: This sword can split into two blades connected by a chain. It can be used to disarm and trip.

Name: Stormshaft Javelin
Description: This javelin can channel electrical energy when thrown.

Name: Switchscythe
Description: This scythe has a blade that can switch positions. It can be used to trip.

Name: Sword, Bastard
Description: A bastard sword is too large to use in one hand without special training; thus, it is an exotic weapon. A character can use a bastard sword two-handed as a martial weapon.

Name: Swordbreaker Dagger
Description: This dagger has a serrated edge designed to catch and break swords. It can be used to disarm and sunder weapons.

Name: Taiaha
Description: This weapon has a club on one end and a spear point on the other. It functions as a double weapon.

Name: Tekko-Kagi
Description: This weapon consists of a metal bar with clawed tips that extends from a fist guard. It can be used to disarm.

Name: Temple Sword
Description: Heavy blades typically used by guardians of religious sites. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Tetsubo
Description: This heavy spiked club is designed to defeat heavily armored opponents.

Name: Thorn Bow
Description: This bow fires thorns instead of arrows.

Name: Thorn Bracer
Description: This bracer has sharp thorns that can be used as a weapon.

Name: Throwing Shield
Description: This shield is specially designed to be thrown. It has the performance weapon quality. Weight varies by shield type.

Name: Tongi
Description: This unique blade has an unusual curved design.

Name: Totem Spear
Description: This spear has a weighted butt that can deal bludgeoning damage. It can be thrown.

Name: Two-Bladed Sword
Description: A two-bladed sword is a double weapon with blades on both ends.

Name: Urgrosh, Dwarven
Description: A dwarven urgrosh is a double weapon with an axe head and a spear point. Dwarves treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Urumi
Description: This flexible sword made of several blades is extremely difficult to use. It has the distracting special feature.

Name: Wahaika
Description: This short, notched club can be used to disarm opponents. It can be thrown.

Name: Wakizashi
Description: These short, slender blades are between 1 to 2 feet long. They have the deadly special feature.

Name: War-Shield, Dwarven
Description: This shield has blades mounted on it. Dwarves treat this as a martial weapon.

Name: Waraxe, Dwarven
Description: A dwarven waraxe is too large to use in one hand without special training; thus, it is an exotic weapon. A Medium character can use a dwarven waraxe two-handed as a martial weapon. A dwarf treats a dwarven waraxe as a martial weapon even when using it in one hand.

Name: Waveblade
Description: This undulating blade can be concealed easily. Monks are proficient with this weapon.

Name: Whip
Description: A whip deals nonlethal damage. It has 15-foot reach. You can use it against foes anywhere within your reach (including adjacent foes). Using a whip provokes an attack of opportunity.

Name: Wrist Launcher
Description: This device is strapped to your wrist and fires small darts or alchemical items.
